title: Batched prefill not guarded against the int8 KV layout
reason: prefillOK/PrefillLast admission never checks the -kv i8 option, so batched prefill treats int8 KV as default f16 and writes half K/V; fix is a named decline.

title: Exact attention_prefill overflows sc[4096] above 4096 keys
reason: Fixed 4096-float threadgroup score array exceeded by reachable contexts up to 32768; PrefillLast checks only ctxCap. Families/options are handled, so not R; fix is a bound decline.
option_or_family: threadgroup float sc[4096] (4096 keys) in exact attention_prefill

title: Small-M prefill pays 64-row tile and low threadgroup occupancy
reason: Performance: GEMM tile shape and occupancy for short passes; bit-identical speedup proposal, no correctness defect.

title: 64-token prefill floor is a gate floor; short prompts run sequentially
reason: Performance: sub-64-token prompts take the slower sequential path because no gate cell was run below 64; not a broken gate or correctness defect.

title: Small-M prefill attention at depth likely latency-bound; stale table
reason: Performance: occupancy/latency of steel attention at small M; the stale table is supporting context, not a gate claim.

title: HiddenLast embeddings run one synchronous command buffer per token
reason: Performance: per-token commit-and-wait in the embeddings path; exactness is a deliberate decision, no correctness defect.

title: hd=64 models never reach the flash-decode attention kernels
reason: Performance: hd=64 takes the named hd==128 decline to the correct legacy kernel; a recorded scope choice, so not R.

title: Block decode-attention kernel instantiated only for group sizes 6 and 7
reason: Performance: other GQA group sizes run the slower but correct attention_fa; deliberate scope, no wrong output, so not R.

title: 1536-key attention floor measured on a kernel it no longer gates
reason: Performance: the depth floor's crossover is stale for the block kernel; both kernels compute correctly.

title: SA GEMV lane mapping leaves the last trip half idle
reason: Performance: idle lanes in the last trip at K=1536/3584; killed after grading but the tail is recorded as real, so not withdrawn.

title: Down projection stays on the slowest coal GEMV body after R18
reason: Performance: down-projection kernel choice and bandwidth; no correctness defect.

title: Paged-expert f16 scale cache duplicates v15-aliased scales on heap
reason: Memory footprint: a redundant 1.43 GB anonymous copy; output is correct and the fix is a redesign, not a registration.

title: Fit guards ignore Metal's 32768 context ceiling and f16 KV
reason: Plan/fit guards register a ceiling only for webgpu and price KV f32; the metal backend falls to the default case. Fix registers it. R vs B: resolveMetalCtxCap does check.
option_or_family: -backend metal (Metal 32768 ctx ceiling, f16 KV precision)
path_missed: guardGIWFit/guardFit and Plan("metal") ceiling and KV pricing

title: Paged MoE prefill runs as M paged decode tokens
reason: Performance/missing feature: paged MoE deliberately declines batched prefill (pinned by a test); no wrong output, so not R.

title: No batched DeltaNet prefill; hybrids prefill as M decode tokens
reason: Missing feature/performance: DeltaNet is deliberately declined from PrefillLast and runs correctly sequentially; not an unregistered default-case miss.

title: Host-grouped MoE expert loop instead of device-side scheduling
reason: Performance: dispatch fan-out, per-layer sync and tile padding in expert-major prefill; no correctness defect.

title: MoE router top-k runs on a single GPU thread
reason: Performance: single-thread routing dispatch; selection is correct and the fix is a bit-identical simdgroup version.

title: gpt-oss MXFP4 weights requantized to int4 absmax/7
reason: Design choice costing 0.6 GB and unquantified fidelity; fix is a native MXFP4 feature. N vs O: the requant arithmetic is correct per its rule.

title: Bit-identical 8-row step unused as prefill for short prompts
reason: Performance: short prompts run sequentially or in a costly pass when an exact faster route exists; no correctness defect.

title: Expert-major MoE prefill default ON on a dense-model gate
reason: Gate defect: the fidelity gate licensing the default ran on a dense model; MoE tests use a tiny fixture, a loose cosine bar and no mutations.

title: Production steel prefill attention kernel has no default-run assertion
reason: Test/gate defect: the steel harness only logs metrics and is env-gated; the G-08 closure note claims coverage nothing asserts.

title: MC3, chunked-prefill, spec-verify gates env-gated; stale invariance record
reason: Gate defect: gates skip by default without a real checkpoint, and the chunk-invariance record predates the steel kernel it is read as covering.

title: Context-ceiling "fact" test only asserts two constants
reason: A test documented as keeping the ceiling a FACT checks only constant arithmetic and cannot detect F-C02's overrun.
